messages:
Sam (PM): Heads up — ACME flagged p95 latency spikes on chat during peak demo traffic. They want launch criteria: p95 <= 150ms for 95% of sessions. Can we scope this for the next sprint or do we need a dedicated workstream?
Jia (Eng): Got the perf dump. Current numbers: p50=80ms p95=420ms p99=900ms, median seq ~40 tokens but heavy tail at 220 tokens for long chats. Main cost is repeated KV loads and attention kernel on long prefixes.
Mike (SRE): Important: batching will help throughput but can hurt p99 tail if we increase batch windows. Also we need circuit-breakers for backpressure so ACME's demo doesn't domino other tenants.
Laura (Product): From ACME: this is a gating ask for pilot. They said they'd consider reserved capacity if we guarantee the SLO. We should evaluate: quick engineering fixes vs. Dedicated offering vs. product trade (like throttling long sessions). Use RICE to compare ideas.
Nadir (ML): Quick wins: prefix KV caching and per-session cache TTL could chop repeated attention cost for long chats. Medium term: int4/qlo8 quant + kernel tuning gives ~25-35% latency drop but needs eval for hallucination/quality.
Jia (Eng): Proposal A: prefix caching + small batching + route short queries to a low-latency tiny model. Effort ~2 eng-weeks to instrument + 1 week to rollout canary.
Jia (Eng): Proposal B: Faster lane (Dedicated) — reserve 2 GPU nodes tuned for low latency, effort 1 week ops + infra cost. Gives best latency but higher monthly cost.
Mike (SRE): Ops note: Dedicated will require network egress adjustments and canary policy. If we do caching, we must add cache invalidation hooks for latest-system messages.
Laura (Product): Quick RICE back-of-envelope: Reach=ACME pilot (~1 customer) but high conversion. Impact=8/10. Confidence=0.6 for caching, 0.4 for quant. Effort: caching=3, dedicated=5 (ops+cost). That pushes caching-first.
Sam (PM): Agreed caching-first seems lowest friction. But we need concrete launch criteria and rollback plan. Can we draft a canary config and a short evaluation checklist?
Jia (Eng): Canary config (sketch):
```
{
  "route": "canary-acme-lowlatency",
  "percentage": 5,
  "model": "gpt-ish-small-lowlatency",
  "features": ["prefix_kv_cache","prefix_ttl=300s","batch_max_ms=8"],
  "fallback": "standard-hosted-model"
}
```
Jia (Eng): We'll run canary for 48h, monitor p95/p99, token quality samples. If p95 < 170ms and no quality regressions, bump to 25% then full.
Nadir (ML): Before enabling quant in prod we must run evals: prompt-set A/B, perplexity, and domain QA. I can run a 2-day eval and share regression alerts.
Mike (SRE): Cost ask: caching will increase memory usage on runtime instances. Dedicated cost estimates: +2x node hours, +net config work. I'll put numbers in the ticket.
deploy-bot: New PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/pulls/3241 — feature/prefix-cache-canary (Jia) :rocket:
Sam (PM): Action items: 1) Jia -> implement prefix cache canary config + smoke tests (due EOW). 2) Nadir -> run quantization evals (48h). 3) Mike -> ops cost delta + canary runbook. 4) Laura -> confirm ACME willingness to pay for Dedicated if cache-only fails. We'll reconvene Tue to decide next steps. :thumbsup:
